Who we are

Five of us, one printer, a spare room

We pooled our money for a single machine and started printing things we wanted for our own desks. People asked where we got them. That turned into this.

We're still small enough that when you message, one of us reads it. If something arrives wrong, we reprint it — that's easier for us than arguing about it.

Bengaluru, India · @aarvika3d

Questions

Before you order

How long until it arrives?

We print after you order, so allow 3–5 working days to make it, plus shipping. Larger pieces like the hexagon wall art take longer — we'll tell you the real number on WhatsApp before you pay.

Can I get a colour that isn't shown?

Usually. We keep white, black and a few others in stock; anything else we order in, which adds a couple of days. Ask before you pay rather than after.

Is it strong? Will it survive a Bengaluru summer?

PLA is rigid and holds up fine indoors. It does soften above roughly 55 °C, so don't leave a piece on a car dashboard in direct sun. That's the one real limitation.

Can I use the bowl and dish for food?

No. 3D printed surfaces have fine layer grooves that trap bacteria, and they aren't dishwasher-safe. Treat them as decorative.

Do you take returns?

Each piece is made for your order, so we don't take general returns. If it arrives damaged or wrong, send us a photo and we'll reprint it.

Can you print something from my own file?

Yes — send an STL or 3MF on WhatsApp and we'll quote. We'll tell you honestly if a model won't print well before taking your money.
